QuestInfo.name: Betty's Request 3
QuestInfo.0: Of course #o3230100#s came after #o2230100#, but for some reason, #b#p1032104##k is very interested in this fact. She's intent on finding out if it's true or not.
QuestInfo.1: #p1032104# believes that some #o2230100#s left their caves and at the plants outside, making them turn green and eventually turning them into #o3230100#s. #p1032104# told you to collect #bsamples#k from the #bGreen Plants#k around #m101000000#. She says you have to use #bnormal attacks#k to take the plants down, and that they look like this: #i4032206#. #i4032961# #t4032961# #b#c4032961##k/5
QuestInfo.2: You gave the #t4032961#s to #p1032104#. She said she'd research why #t4032961#s have such a strong effect on #o2230100#s. You don't know why she cared so much, but it felt good to help people in need.

0.0: I was prepared to spend hours researching the hunting patterns of #o2230100#s and #o3230100#s, but your hypothesis gives me an idea.
0.1: It seems to me that the #o2230100#s left their caves, and when they ate the plants outside, they turned green and eventually turned into Curse Eyes.
0.2: Let's see if we're right! #o2230100#s and #t4032960#s isn't enough to prove our hypothesis. I need plant samples from around #m101000000#. Would you bring me #b5#l #b#t4032961#s#k?

yes.0: The plants look like this: #i4032206#  Magic and skills don't work on them, so use #bregular attacks#k to collect the samples.
yes.1: We could be on the verge of a great discovery here! Isn't it exciting?

no.0: Aren't you curious? I wouldn't even be doing this experiment if it weren't for you!

1.0: You have the #t4032961#s? Thank you! Now, let's see just how big an effect they have on #o2230100#s... Thank you for giving me a new direction. I'll let you know when I have another job for you.

yes.0: Here, take this. I got it in a big event a while back, but you'll get more use out of it than me.

item.0: You don't have the #b#t4032961##k yet? Remember, you have to use #bregular attacks#k to collect them.
